definitions.explanation: An organized group of people who share a common interest, especially extracurricular activity clubs at schools.
An entertainment venue for dancing and nightlife.

examples.japanese: テニスクラブに{入|はい}る。
{学校|がっこう}のクラブ{活動|かつどう}は{週|しゅう}に{三|さん}{回|かい}ある。
examples.english: School club activities are three times a week.

examples.japanese: {中学生|ちゅうがくせい}のとき、{科学|かがく}クラブで{実験|じっけん}をするのが{楽|たの}しかった。
examples.english: When I was in junior high, I enjoyed doing experiments in the science club.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}にクラブに{遊|あそ}びに{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go clubbing on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {渋谷|しぶや}のクラブは{金曜|きんよう}の{夜|よる}になると{人|ひと}でいっぱいになる。
examples.english: Clubs in Shibuya get packed on Friday nights.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (club/organization) is the most common usage. In Japanese schools, クラブ{活動|かつどう} or {部活|ぶかつ} refers to extracurricular clubs, which play a central role in student life. クラブ is more common in elementary and some junior high schools, while {部活|ぶかつ} is standard in junior high and high school.

Sense 2 (nightclub) is context-dependent and usually clear from the situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クラブ{活動|かつどう}: club activities
- ゴルフクラブ: golf club (organization or equipment)
- クラブに{入|はい}る: to join a club
- {会員制|かいいんせい}クラブ: members-only club
